Requirements The target is at full Hit Points.

You imprint a temporal checkpoint on the target's life-force, recording its current vitality. For the duration, the target carries this temporal anchor.

If the target would be reduced to 0 HP or would die outright, whether from death effects, a Massacre's death-on-critical-failure, or a similar cause, at any point during the duration, instead of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Dying]{Dying} or falling @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Unconscious]{Unconscious}, the checkpoint activates: the target immediately regains 9d8+72 Hit Points, as if restored by a rank-9 two-action Heal, any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Dying]{Dying} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Wounded]{Wounded} conditions are removed, and the temporal anchor is consumed, ending the spell. The target's position does not change when the checkpoint activates.

The checkpoint activates only once per casting and then the spell ends. If the duration expires without the checkpoint triggering, the spell ends with no effect.

Heightened (10th) The checkpoint restores the target to full HP instead of a fixed amount, and the duration increases to 8 hours.
